2607.14865.title: The Energy Society: A Simulation Environment for Studying Agent Cooperation under Survival Pressure
2607.14865.paper_summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent environments whose incentives can shape their behavior. We introduce The Energy Society, a minimal survival economy for studying how competitive and cooperative incentives affect emergent behavior when inference cost is directly tied to survival: Agents spend energy based on model size when generating tokens, regain energy by completing jobs or receiving donations, and deactivate if their energy reaches zero. We compare competitive and cooperative objectives against a baseline setting and several control variants. Across experiments, larger models consistently consume the most energy and spend more energy than they gain, even in those settings where token cost is not size-dependent. Cooperative incentives substantially alter behavior: agents donate to reactivate others, sometimes at the cost of their own survival, and job allocation changes. Ablations reveal that allowing agents to recommend actions to each other supports coordination and ambitious job selection, while memory helps agents calibrate risk from past outcomes. Agents rarely choose direct sabotage, but show more subtle signs of self-serving behavior in the competitive setting. The Energy Society is a compact testbed for studying the interaction between token costs and group incentives under a survival pressure. Source code is available at https://github.com/LucasBergholdt/EnergySociety
2607.14865.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基礎的代理在多代理環境中越來越多地被部署，這些環境的激勵可以塑造它們的行為。<lb/>我們介紹了能源社會，一個最小化的生存經濟體，用於研究競爭性和合作性激勵如何影響當推理成本與生存直接相關時的突現行為：代理在生成標記時根據模型大小消耗能量，通過完成工作或接受捐贈來恢復能量，並在能量降至零時停用。<lb/>我們將競爭性和合作性目標與基準設置和幾個控制變體進行比較。<lb/>在實驗中，更大的模型始終消耗最多的能量，並且消耗的能量超過其獲得的能量，即使在標記成本不依賴於大小的設置中也是如此。<lb/>合作性激勵顯著改變行為：代理捐贈以重新啟動其他代理，有時以自身生存為代價，工作分配也會改變。<lb/>消融實驗顯示，允許代理相互推薦行動有助於協調和雄心勃勃的工作選擇，而記憶幫助代理根據過去的結果調整風險。<lb/>代理很少選擇直接破壞，但在競爭環境中顯示出更微妙的自利行為跡象。<lb/>能源社會是一個緊湊的測試平台，用於研究在生存壓力下標記成本和群體激勵之間的相互作用。<lb/>源代碼可在 https://github.com/LucasBergholdt/EnergySociety 獲得。
